text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr sets her sights on Sprint 
and Mile GⅠ races moving forward. To do 
so, there are two rivals she must take 
note of.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One of them is Daiichi Ruby of the 
"Illustrious Clan." Carrying the weight of 
her family's name, the aura of command she 
radiated felt extraordinarily heavy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The other is Daitaku Helios, who 
repeatedly unleashes tremendous runaway 
bursts with a speed that seems bottomless.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr was stunned by the height 
of the two walls she had to overcome. 
Having broadened her horizons and come to 
know her opponents, she had let the 
pressure get to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Together with her Trainer, they decided to 
devise a strategy on how to win. 
—Meanwhile, breaking news was about to 
cause quite a stir in the world.
